verdict: No paid activity this period; organic local presence is your only active channel.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no paid advertising ran on Meta or Google, so all engagement came from your Google Business Profile. That profile recorded 43 actions — directions, web clicks, and one call — but activity softened sharply in the most recent week, dropping roughly 55% compared to the week prior, consistent with reduced local search visibility or a seasonal dip in intent. Website sessions held relatively steady at 190 over the period, though no conversions were captured in that window; conversion tracking is being reviewed to ensure nothing is under-reported. The priority going into the next period is restoring paid activity so lead generation has a reliable, controllable source alongside organic.
